trophies.guide: 1) Witness something strange in Leonida — this hidden trophy is for an odd world event, likely a UFO or cryptid-style encounter. 2) Explore unusual places at night and watch the skies; these events are usually tied to a specific spot and time. 3) The exact event and location are belum dicek di dalam game and are listed as a dispute in this guide.

trophies.guide: 1) Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts — fences buy marked bills, and Yasmani in Little Cuba pays the best rate. 2) You need the Dye Pack Jammer from the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check before you can sell marked bills at all. 3) Bank vaults are the best source of marked bills — up to $205,000 per vault at Lombank Downtown and Lombank Ocean Beach.

trophies.guide: 1) Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, food and vehicle upgrades all count. 2) This comes naturally over a full playthrough; if you are short at the end, buy expensive items you still need. 3) Track spending in the Progress menu; the exact shop list is belum dicek di dalam game.

trophies.guide: 1) Buy all 8 garage properties — Push Square lists Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000) and 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000) among them. 2) Garages give you parking and storage; buy them as you find them, since prices vary by location. 3) The full list of 8 garages and prices is belum dicek di dalam game.
